origin.description: Bogacki-Shampine Runge-Kutta pair of orders 2 and 3 with an adaptive step.
origin.usage: ode23(f, t0, tfinal, y0, ..., rtol = 1e-3, atol = 1e-6)

arguments.name: y0
arguments.text: Initial value, a vector or one column.

origin.details: y' = -y, y(0) = 1, on [0, 0.4]. The check vector is the solution column.
origin.value: Bogacki-Shampine Runge-Kutta pair of orders 2 and 3 with an adaptive step.
